dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Finn arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. While in care, Finn has been observed to be highly dog reactive, noted to pull hard towards other dogs while barking with hackles raised. During one instance after reacting to a dog on the street, Finn redirected onto the handler biting their pants. Afterwards, he continued to lunge at the handler while baring teeth and snarling. While lunging, Finn was able to bite the handler's sleeve. Finn's previous owner described him as active and affectionate. Medically, Finn has CIRDC and mild-moderate dental disease.
